Aisha: Quick ask — assemble a tiny GA gate checklist (one liners): SLA blurb, runbook link + owner, oncall thresholds, monitoring alert rule, pricing smoke owner. Need EOD sign-offs.

Daniel: I got monitoring/oncall. Quick checks: 10m smoke @ 11:30 UTC; p95 < 350ms; page SRE if 5xx > 5% over 5m; include runbook URL in alert.

Ravi: I'll own pricing + fallback check. Plan: 10m load, verify X-Cost-Tag=ga-mini in billing, confirm fallback to quantized-small reduces p95 by >=20% if triggered.

DocsBot: Created ticket MINI-42 "GA mini-gate" assigned Aisha/Daniel/Ravi due EOD.

Daniel: Ack — running burnin at 11:30, will paste results.

Ravi: Ack — pricing job queued at 11:35. Will attach CSV to MINI-42.

(11:40) Daniel: Burnin finished. p95=320ms; one 25s spike at 11:33 triggered auto-fallback and alert included runbook link. Logged snapshot to MINI-42.

(11:58) Ravi: Pricing smoke done. Billing records show X-Cost-Tag present; token counts match load. Fallback exercised once and reduced p95 by ~28%. CSV uploaded to MINI-42.

Aisha: Drafted SLA line: "We target 99.5% uptime for hosted inference, excluding scheduled maintenance and force majeure." Runbook link (draft): internal://docs/ga/mini-gate.md (placeholder). Please react with :white_check_mark: when done and I'll send handoff to sales/support.

Daniel: :white_check_mark:

Ravi: :white_check_mark:

Aisha: Thanks — sending handoff in 10m.
